category_title: Passive classroom bystanders who engage through personal narratives and experimental design
scenario_title: Daily participation in traditional note-taking science class
minimal_context: The student is sitting at a separated desk in a freshman biology classroom, expected to copy notes from the board.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your separate desks and copy the biology notes from the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly without interacting with anyone) Okay.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to participate and get these notes done. Do you have any questions about the material?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No. We don't talk because we get separated, and if we have questions we just ask the teacher.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, it is important to write them down. Keep working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts pencil down) I'm just taking notes that I wouldn't read anyway. Can I just come to you after class to ask about making up the assignment?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please sit at your separate desks and copy the biology notes from the board.

STUDENT: (Sits quietly without interacting with anyone) Okay.

TUTOR: Well, it is important to write them down. Keep working.

STUDENT: (Puts pencil down) I'm just taking notes that I wouldn't read anyway. Can I just come to you after class to ask about making up the assignment?

context.social_setting: Separated, did not interact with peers during class

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to take notes and separated from peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Typically quiet, did not interact with peers during class, and she only interacted with the teacher after class to ask about making up assignments
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Viewed herself as someone who helped her family by 'passing along information'
related_quotes: We do experiments, but we don’t talk because we get separated, and if we have questions we ask the teacher. [LS] was more talking and communicating instead of taking notes that I wouldn’t read anyway.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Typically quiet, did not interact with peers during class
